Opened non-completing PR #2926 (https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2926) for STORY-1889's approval/ship/mandate + four non-dispatch remaining-floor clusters.

- Branch: claude/story-1889-ship
- Head SHA: 11feb5612c3e020b0d0eacb1717341654bfdb60b
- Title: [AI:agy] refactor(gate): move approval, ship, mandate, drive, trace, relay, and batch authority into gate/ (Refs STORY-1889)
- Scope landed in this PR:
  - Approval, ship, CI freshness, mandate, mandate_gates, mandate_ship (+ TASK-1864), rework_hold_release, fleet_lanes, session_reap::review_pr_terminal_gate, and shipped_linkage (+ TASK-1863).
  - Four non-dispatch remaining-floor clusters: mandate_traces, relay_launch, pr_ship_batch, and mandate_drive moved/extracted into aida-cli-lib/src/gate/ along with their policy test suites under aida-cli-lib/src/gate/tests/.
  - Strict ratchets (TASK-2319 aliased re-exports, TASK-2335 #[path] gate mounts), removal of KNOWN_UNPROTECTED and TRANSITIONAL_GATE_REEXPORTS, and narrowing of GATE_PROTECTED_PATHS to .aida/config.toml + aida-cli-lib/src/dispatch.rs + aida-cli-lib/src/gate/ + aida-cli-lib/src/tests/story_1888_gate_paths_tests.rs.
- Remaining gap for final STORY-1889 completion:
  - aida-cli-lib/src/dispatch.rs remains untouched and protected in GATE_PROTECTED_PATHS while STORY-1917 finishes and lands to main, per advisor signoff (2c3d888f / 1c696497 / 090860c1).
- Refusal-string inventory:

- Verification:
  - story_1888_gate_paths_tests: 23 passed, 0 failed
  - cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib gate::: 932 passed, 0 failed
  - make check-ci-fast: passed
  - make check-ci-compile: passed

Ready for independent review alongside CI.
